scope_note: RGB/master point recipes v1 remain compatible. Recipe v2 adds explicit linear-sRGB Y-ratio luminance, not Lab L*. Recipe v3 adds an independent Rust-owned four-region parametric stage before point curves, with split-aligned floating LUTs. Basic integrated CI/Qoder checks are recorded in docs/development/parametric-curves-verification.md; native UI acceptance remains pending. Eyedroppers and live/full-source histograms remain separate unfinished features. Original frozen registry is unchanged. Levels is a separate display-sRGB operator with explicit active-channel input clipping and reversible output endpoints; histogram and eyedroppers remain separate.

Scalar archive/capture and neutral reset are supported source contracts; active generic preset/batch application remains refused until target-specific full-image visual review is implemented. Existing canonical eye/teeth enhancement scalar owner, with independent tooth brightness, yellow removal, flash red-eye and eye-white purification. Purification targets limited local dull blemishes and colour casts, not merely brightness; it is not an alias of sclera brightness, veins or red-eye. Geometry-derived support is not semantic segmentation; before/after review is required and complete blemish detection is not claimed. Legacy combined teeth and omitted optional scalar semantics stay unchanged; wrinkle intent remains a separate operation. Finite 0..1 scale and neutral zero are local implementation choices, not published handbook ranges/defaults. Presets contain only versioned scalars; each target recomputes its own support and confirmed-face batch preserves target-owned masks/history. Generic derived-source legacy presets remain refused. Runtime, numerical and photographic acceptance UNRUN; whole-feature official acceptance is not claimed.
